property_summary: When non-owner calls setOwner(address), the reference contract sets owner (require(msg.sender == owner) passes because msg.sender is owner in that scenario?), but the mutant always reverts (require(false)), so after a call by a non-owner, the reference would revert and not change owner, while the mutant also reverts — wait, need to pick a scenario where they differ. Actually, for the reference, onlyOwner checks msg.sender == owner; for the mutant, it always reverts. So a call from owner will succeed in reference and fail in mutant. Concrete: owner calls setOwner(newOwner). After call, reference has new owner, mutant owner unchanged (since revert).
change_summary: Replace require with require(false) so onlyOwner always reverts
